description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a variable on the x-axis and three different values: Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment. The x-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 15 to 55, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Values” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.88 to 1.00, with tick labels at intervals of 0.02. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents Accuracy; it begins at approximately 0.92 at x=15, increases to 0.98 at x=25, then fluctuates between 0.97 and 0.99 until reaching 0.99 at x=55. A green line, marked with triangular data points, represents Confidence; it begins at approximately 0.98 at x=15, increases to 0.99 at x=20, then decreases to 0.97 at x=25, and rises to 0.99 at x=55. A red line, marked with square data points, represents Alignment; it begins at approximately 0.96 at x=15, decreases to 0.92 at x=20, increases to 0.99 at x=30, and remains at 0.99 until x=55.
